parsed.why: No criminalisation, anti-discrimination and hate-crime laws covering SOGI, UN review operating. Weighed down by uneven enforcement, documented hostile attitudes and ten logged trans violence cases; no documented traveller-facing restriction or state targeting.

Police invoke the modesty law to detain and extort trans women as a documented pattern, with rape in custody, birth-sex prison placement and institutional impunity. Paper anti-discrimination articles don't operate — state-tolerated targeting dominates.

Sodomy statutes remain on books though reported unenforced; no protections, no equality clause, documented service discrimination and fear of police. No trans-specific violence record. Structural thinness and absence of recourse set it below dossier 1.

Decriminalisation struck down and upheld, harassment act naming gender identity, courts and regional treaty constraining the 'homosexual' entry bar, highest regional acceptance polling. Religious hostility and an unresolved port-of-entry statute remain open questions, not exposures.

Courts repeatedly rule for trans people (restroom advice unlawful, surgery mandate struck down), positive visitor neighbourhoods, police deploying to protect Pride. Held below the ceiling by the refused hospitalisation guidelines, organised anti-Pride violence and no national anti-discrimination law.
